name: std::stack<T,Container>::push
intro:
Pushes the given element value to the top of the stack.

1) Equivalent to: c.push_back(value).

2) Equivalent to: c.push_back(std::move(value)).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
value

 -

 the value of the element to push

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Equal to the complexity of Container::push_back.

summary: Pushes the given element value to the top of the stack.
